messages.author: chloe.nguyen
messages.content: Pinning Aurelian #CASE-2026-047 here: kickoff is Monday. The GP's first question is joint signers, so I'm answering from Minh's #CASE-2025-014 post-mortem rather than from memory.

messages.author: sarah.tran
messages.content: Schema side: reusing cayman_fatca_v2 is a parameter change only. Annex D (hardware wallet custody) is the unknown. I'll scope signed-message proof per chain by Wednesday.

messages.author: chloe.nguyen
messages.content: Tidemark #CASE-2026-049 lands on Ops too: EUR/JPY wires are off by 0.02-0.11% of the call. Carrow's ±0.25% tolerance policy from #CASE-2025-038 fits, but the GP has to adopt it under their own LPA first.

messages.author: elena.rostova
messages.content: Aurelian's sovereign side letters drop the first MFN bracket to US$15M (#CASE-2026-047). Starting from David's approved redlines in #CASE-2025-052, not a blank draft.

messages.author: ryan.miller
messages.content: Altmark (#CASE-2026-048) wants Swiss client confidentiality language as well. Is there anything in the library?

messages.author: elena.rostova
messages.content: Nothing for Swiss banking secrecy: that one is net new, and I'll draft it with their Swiss counsel. For Aurelian's 10% look-through we reuse David's four-tier schema from #CASE-2025-067 with the scope set to ALL_INVESTORS.

messages.author: ryan.miller
messages.content: Altmark RFP #CASE-2026-048 is due 6 Nov. Starting from the Valmont master response bank in #CASE-2025-081.

messages.author: marcus.vance
messages.content: Before anyone quotes AI-07 or DORA-31: that bank was last verified in October 2025. I'll re-export the EU egress allow-list this week.

messages.author: ryan.miller
messages.content: Agreed: no answer goes to Altmark without a fresh last_verified date. The wealth-manager questions follow Brookhaven (#CASE-2026-003), adjusted for European mandates.

messages.author: chloe.nguyen
messages.content: Tidemark escalation #CASE-2026-049: Cityline- and Rhone Union-hosted LPs are missing portal invites, with no bounces. That's the same signature as Blackridge in #CASE-2026-011.

messages.author: marcus.vance
messages.content: Confirmed: Tidemark's sending identity isn't DKIM-aligned. Fixing it now; the whitelisting guide goes to the banks' IT contacts afterwards.

messages.author: chloe.nguyen
messages.content: 118 dormant Tidemark users ahead of the Q1 tax distributions. Scheduling the K-1 pre-flight runbook's T-21 timeline against their distribution date.

messages.author: sarah.tran
messages.content: DealLedger export for Tidemark #CASE-2026-049: 38 trusts duplicated per trustee and 21 with trustees concatenated into the name. Running it through the Ardent normalization template from #CASE-2025-029.

messages.author: marcus.vance
messages.content: The CRM map needs a DealLedger version; Relata field names don't carry over. Happy to pair on it tomorrow morning.

messages.author: sarah.tran
messages.content: DealLedger map v0.1 is drafted. Custodial IRAs now map to the beneficiary, FBO the custodian, instead of the custodian as investor.
